title: Resolve Place state through XDG_STATE_HOME and runtime independently
description: At translator 751c326 and current main, placement::resolve_place reads XDG_RUNTIME_DIR for Runtime but always reads HOME/.local/state for State, ignoring XDG_STATE_HOME. Belief runtime-only CLIs call resolve_place and then use only Runtime, so they also require HOME or a State root merely to find a runtime socket. The XDG Base Directory contract makes XDG_STATE_HOME the State base, defaults an unset or empty value to HOME/.local/state, and treats relative configured paths as invalid. Correct this once at the shared Place boundary and expose Runtime resolution without State requirements.
design: Keep Place as the composition of independently resolved Runtime and State. State resolution uses an absolute XDG_STATE_HOME when present, with the approved XDG fallback to HOME/.local/state when unset or empty; relative-value behavior follows the standard invalid-value rule. Runtime resolution reads only XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and the metaflow name. Consumers that need only Runtime use that capability rather than constructing a whole Place. Belief Nexus repins translator and switches its ordinary and meta CLIs to the runtime-only capability; belief-pair continues to accept its explicit typed Place.
acceptance_criteria: Executable translator tests prove distinct HOME and XDG_STATE_HOME selects XDG_STATE_HOME; unset and empty XDG_STATE_HOME select HOME/.local/state; invalid relative roots receive the approved XDG treatment; Runtime remains XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/metaflow/name. A runtime-only resolver succeeds with HOME and XDG_STATE_HOME absent and still refuses missing, empty, non-Unicode, or relative XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and unsafe metaflow names. A Belief Nexus consumer test proves ordinary and meta runtime socket lookup no longer requires HOME, then its translator pin is updated and full checks pass in both repositories.
close_reason: State now honors absolute XDG_STATE_HOME with XDG HOME fallback, and resolve_runtime is independent of HOME/State; full Prometheus flake checks pass.
